Name: Fancy Doors
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46789]Door Furniture[/url] that uses Content Patcher to add six new fancy doors, based on the vanilla game's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Decorative_Door]Decorative Doors[/url].

All six doors can be rotated and flipped, colored, and optionally locked via the pack's config.json file.

Doors can be bought from Robin for 2000g (you can change the price in the config).

Door animations were created on commission by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Hxoni/mods]Hxoñi[/url].

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46789]Door Furniture[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
